brief:
Australia, Canada, the UK, and Italy have called on Israel to allow safe passage of critical humanitarian aid into Gaza as deadly floods worsen the territory's crisis ahead of winter. The governments issued the joint appeal amid reports of deteriorating conditions for civilians facing both immediate flooding and the approaching cold season.

The appeal reflects growing international pressure on Israel to facilitate aid delivery to Gaza's population, The Guardian reported. Officials from the four countries stressed the urgency of opening aid corridors before winter compounds an already severe humanitarian emergency.
dek: Deadly floods in Gaza have created a dire humanitarian crisis, as the governments of Australia, Canada, the UK and Italy call on Israel to allow the safe passage of critical aid to civilians before winter sets in.
title: Four nations urge Israel to open Gaza aid corridors before winter
